Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this one-side game and it has blown Group 1 of the Super Six completely open. The action in the inaugural ICC Under-19 Women’s T20 World Cup continues on Sunday 22nd January as India Women Under-19 will look to come back stronger from this loss against Sri Lanka Women Under-19 and that game will start at 5.15 pm IST (11.45 am GMT) at the Senwes Park in Potchefstroom. Our build-up will begin well in advance so do join us for it. Until then, it is goodbye and cheers!

Rhys McKenna the skipper of Australia Women Under-19 says that the first game against Bangladesh Women Under-19 made them work harder to get here. Adds that it was a very good performance from her bowlers. Mentions that the preparation will be similar and they will look to continue this form in their next game.

Shafali Verma the captain for India Women Under-19 says that we were not able to put on the batting performance that they wanted but will learn from their mistakes and come back stronger. Admits that it is not a difficult pitch but there was a bit for the bowler and all the credit goes to the Australia Women Under-19 bowlers who bowled really well. Claims that there is always a bit of pressure playing tournaments like this but they back themselves to stay together and come out on top.

Milly Illingworth is the Player of the Match for taking two crucial wickets at the start of the inning which never allowed India Women Under-19 to get back into the game. She says that she was really happy with the wicket of Shafali Verma. Claims that she loves to bowl fast and enjoys it. Mentions that it was a complete performance from the team and they deserved the win.
Time for the presentations...

India Women Under-19 lost the game courtesy of their poor batting performance in the first inning as they were bundled out for a measly total with just three batters reaching double figures. Shweta Sehrawat top scored once again with 21 but could not really get going. Sienna Ginger was the pick of the bowlers claiming three wickets for 13 runs in her four overs with Milly Illingworth and Maggie Clark chipping in with two wickets. Rhys McKenna and Ella Hayward took one wicket each and set up an easy run chase for the batters.

Australia Women Under-19 got off to a positive start as they looked to take the attack to the India Women Under-19 bowlers but lost Kate Pelle, Sienna Ginger, and Ella Hayward for nine runs to send some jitters down the dressing room. Claire Moore showed her quality once again as she got together with the talented Amy Smith to settle all nerves and put together a 51-run partnership to take their side over the finish line. We anticipated this to be a blockbuster clash but Australia Women Under-19 managed to make this a walk in the park with a professional performance.

Australia Women Under-19 have completed a dominating win and condemned India Women Under-19 to their first loss of the competition. They have managed to get over the finish line with 7 wickets in hand and with 37 balls to spare and have asserted their credentials as the favorites of this competition despite their opening game loss. The India Women Under-19 bowlers had very little to work with and could not bother the Australia Women Under-19 batters as much as they would have liked. Titas Sadhu, Sonam Yadav, and Archana Devi did claim a wicket each but they needed many more to have a chance in this game.

Claire Moore hits the winning runs! Shafali Verma darts this one full and on middle, Claire Moore drills it towards long on for a single. There is handshakes all around in the middle. Australia Women Under-19 win by seven wickets.
SIX! BANG! Claire Moore looks in a hurry now! This is tossed up, on middle, Claire Moore skips down the track and smokes it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Short again and on off, Claire Moore punches it towards covers.
FOUR! Fine shot! This is short and on middle, Claire Moore stays there and pulls it towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.

A mix-up in the middle, but no hram done! This is flatter, full and on middle, Amy Smith uses her feet and mistimes her drive towards mid on where there is a fumble. The batters decide to take the run and Smith just makes it at the bowler's end.
Change of ends for Shafali Verma.
Floated and on middle, Amy Smith dances down the track and lofts it towards long on for a run. Australia Women Under-19 12 runs away from victory now!
Short and outside off, Claire Moore drags it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted full and outside off. Claire Moore sweeps this towards deep square leg and collects a couple of runs. Just 14 runs are needed now.
Sonam Yadav floats this one full and in line with the stumps. Amy Smith knocks this down to long on for one.
Bowls this one slightly short and outside off. Amy Smith gets beaten but the turn and dabs this towards the off side.

SIX! Amy Smith wants to end this in a hurry now! Sonam Yadav tosses this full and outside off, Amy Smith comes to the pitch of the ball in a flash and lofts this over long off for a biggie. She looks to be set here.
Sonam Yadav is back on.
Continues to bowl full and attacks the stumps. Amy Smith eases this down to long on and will retain strike with a run.
Flighted delivery bowled outside off on a fuller length. Claire Moore shimmies down the pitch and lofts this towards long on for one.
Loopy delivery bowled full ands outside the off stump. Amy Smith strokes this down to long off for a single.
Tosses this one slightly short and outside off. Amy Smith rocks back and slaps this towards cover.
Is that dropped? Flights this one full and outside off. Amy Smith looks to sweep and there is a slight sound has the ball passes the bat. Richa Ghosh does not hold on to the ball behind the wicket.
Parshavi Chopra flights this one full and outside off. Claire Moore charges down the wicket and lofts this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Goes full once again and in line with the stumps. Claire Moore powers this one straight to long on for one more.
Continues to float this one full and outside the off pole. Amy Smith gets down the wicket again and hits it to wide long on but has to settle for a single.
Tosses this one full as well and just outside off. Claire Moore shimmies down the wicket and mistimes her shot to long on for one.
Flights this one full and outside off. Amy Smith sweeps this towards deep square leg for a run.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside off. Claire Moore clips this towards long on for a single.
Shafali Verma floats this one full and angling down leg. Claire Moore looks to flick this leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads.

DRINKS! The players will take some refreshments. Australia Women Under-19 got off to a good start but lost three wickets in quick succession to stutter a bit. Amy Smith and Claire Moore have stabilized the innings since then and now need 32 runs in 60 balls to win this game which should not be a tough ask. India Women Under-19 need to claim some quick wickets if they are to have any chance of winning this game but looks like a tough proposition. Shafali Verma to continue after the break.
Floated around middle, Claire Moore skips down the track and drills it towards wide long off for one more.
Short and on off, Claire Moore moves back and cuts it towards covers.
Flighted, full and on middle, Claire Moore tucks it towards short mid-wicket where the fielder does well to stop the run.
Tossed up, on middle, Amy Smith uses her feet and drives it towards long on for a single.
Fires this one full and down the leg, Amy Smith misses her sweep. Wided.
Floated, full and on off, Amy Smith looks to play at it, but misses.
FOUR! A pressure releasing boundary for Australia Women Under-19! Parshavi Chopra starts with a short delivery, outisde off, Amy Smith cuts it past the the diving point fielder for a boundary.
Parshavi Chopra has been handed the ball and is brought into the attack.
Quicker, full and on off, Claire Moore mistimes her drive towards the bowler. End of a really tidy over!
A low full toss, on off, Claire Moore drills it back towards the bowler.
Floated, on middle, Amy Smith uses her feet again and works it towards long on for a single.
A bit short and on off, Amy Smith gudies it towards backward point.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Amy Smith comes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler where Shafali Verma collects it and gives a stare to the batter.
Shafali Verma starts with a flatter delivery, full and on off, Amy Smith knocks it towards extra covers.
Shafali Verma has brought herself into the attack.
A single to end the over as this full delivery is drilled down to long off by Smith.
Floated, full and on off, Amy Smith leans on and blocks it out.

In the air...safe! This is flighted, full and on off, Claire Moore uses her feet to whip away, but gets a top edge as the ball holds up in the pitch a bit. Luckily for her, it falls in no man's land in the extra cover region.
Short again and on middle, Claire Moore pulls it straight to mid-wicket.
Shortish and on middle, Claire Moore turns it towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up, on off, Amy Smith comes down the track and pushes it towards extra covers for a single.
A low full toss, on off, Claire Moore knocks it back to the bowler. Archana Devi collects it and fakes a throw towards the batting end to show some aggression.
A bit short and on off, Claire Moore pushes it towards covers.
Quicker one, full and on off, Claire Moore lobs it towards the long off fence where the fielder from long on comes across and dives to her left to stop it. Two runs taken!
Tossed up, full and on middle, Amy Smith uses her feet and tucks it through square leg for a run.
Floated, short and on off, turning in, Amy Smith moves back and dabs it late past short third man for a brace.
Flighted, full and on off, Claire Moore drills it towards long on for a single.
Flatter, full and on middle, Amy Smith look to work it away, but gets an outside edge towards third man. Two runs taken!
Looped up, full and on off, Amy Smith pushes it back to the bowler.
Amy Smith strides out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Sonam Yadav strikes now! She once again bowls this slower through the air, short and outside off, Ella Hayward tries to reach for it and hangs her bat there. The ball takes the outside edge and loops towards cover-point where Hrishita Basu takes a dolly. Ella Hayward goes back to the hut now as Australia Women Under-19 lose their third wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Hrishita Basu b Sonam Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: Flighted and around off, Ella Hayward skips down the track and tries to slog it away, but gets an thick outisde edge towards the vacant third man region and comes back for the second.
Slows it up a bit, on off, Ella Hayward leans on and blocks it out to the off side.
FOUR! Ella Hayward greets Sonam Yadav with a boundary! Yada begins with a tossed up, delivery, full and on middle, Ella Hayward swats it away wide of long on for a boundary.
Sonam Yadav replaces Titas Sadhu.

Floats this one full and in line with the stumps. Claire Moore uses the depth of the crease and looks to work it leg side but gets a leading edge into the off side. A good over from Archana Devi ​​​​as just one run and one wicket comes from it.
Bowls this one slightly short and outside off. Claire Moore rocks back and punches this straight to cover.
Goes full once again and outside the off stump. Claire Moore knocks this firmly towards mid off.
Tosses this one full and in line with the stumps. Ella Hayward eases this down to long on for a single to get off the mark.
Ella Hayward comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Archana Devi gets a wicket straight away and India Women Under-19 will start believing here as both the openers are back in the shed! Archana Devi flights this one full and outside off. Sienna Ginger hits this in the air straight to Parshavi Chopra at cover who takes a fine catch. Australia Women Under-19 lose their second wicket in quick time and will be under a bit of pressure now.
Commentary.Howout: c Parshavi Chopra b Archana Devi

Commentary.Commentary: Flights this one high into the air and bowls this outside off. Sienna Ginger strokes this straight to cover.
Archana Devi comes into the attack now.
Goes full once again and outside off. Sienna Ginger hits this aerially towards deep cover for a single.
Bowls this on a good length and outside off. Sienna Ginger punches this towards point.
Titas Sadhu bowls this full and into the stumps. Claire Moore eases this down to long on for a single to get off the mark.
Claire Moore walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! One shot too many from Kate Pelle and she has to depart! Titas Sadhu claims first blood and this is a good comeback from the fast bowler. Bowls this one short and outside off. Kate Pelle looks to pull but gets a top edge that goes towards backward square leg. Gongadi Trisha at short fine leg runs across to her left and takes a comfortable catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mannat Kashyap b Titas Sadhu

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Kate Pelle looking to be aggressive here! Titas Sadhu continues to bowl full and outside off. Kate Pelle charges down the wicket and lofts this towards long off for four more runs.
FOUR! Boundaries are flowing! Titas Sadhu goes full and outside off. Kate Pelle stokes this towards deep cover for four runs.

FOUR! Australia Women Under-19 looking to get to the target in a hurry! Mannat Kashyap flights this one full and outside off. Sienna Ginger shimmies down the wicket and hits this over mid off for yet another boundary.
Goes full once again and outside the off stump. Sienna Ginger strokes this towards cover-point and there is a good diving stop from the fielder.
This is full and in line with the stumps. Kate Pelle clips this towards mid on.

FOUR! Edgy boundary from Kate Pelle but Australia Women Under-19 accumulating the runs steadily! Mannat Kashyap bowls a loopy delivery full and outside off. Kate Pelle charges down the wicket and goes hard at the ball. Gets an outside edge to third man for four runs.
Gives more flight this time and serves this full, outside off. Kate Pelle thumps this straight to mid off.
Mannat Kashyap floats this one full and into the stumps. Kate Pelle tucks this towards deep square leg and they take another brace.
Goes full once again and outside the off pole. Sienna Ginger strokes this towards deep point and some good fielding restricts them to a couple of runs.
Persists with the outside off stump line on a fuller length. Kate Pelle thumps this to the long off fielder who has been pushed back for a single.
Continues to bowl full and outside off. Kate Pelle goes hard at the ball but hits it straight to mid off.
Bowls this one really full and in line with the stumps. Kate Pelle digs this out towards mid on.
Goes full this time and outside the off stump. Kate Pelle charges down the pitch and looks to drive through the off side but is beaten.
Titas Sadhu begins with a good-length delivery just outside the off stump. Kate Pelle blocks this towards cover.
Titas Sadhu to share the attack.
Goes back to tossing this one full and outside off. Sienna Ginger pushes this straight to the cover fielder.
Slightly short this time and outside off. Sienna Ginger goes back and cuts this straight to cover-point.
Bowls this one full as well and outside the off stump. Sienna Ginger shuffles down the pitch and knocks this to the left of mid off. A slight misfield allows them to take two.
A loopy delivery bowled full and outside off. Sienna Ginger knocks this straight to cover.
Tosses this one full and into the stumps. Sienna Ginger shimmies down the wicket and miscues her shot to wide long on. They take a couple of runs.
NO BALL! Mannat Kashyap bowls this short and way down leg. The batter leaves this alone but the bowler has overstepped and the umpire calls no ball. There will be a Free-hit.
Kate Pelle and Australia Women Under-19 are up and running straight away! Mannat Kashyap flights this one full and in line with the stumps. Kate Pelle eases this down to long on for a single.
